metadata.description: qmsWrapper user how-to authoring with annotated screenshots

plugins.name: howto
plugins.description: Turn a tested feature or a validation sheet into a user-facing how-to document with annotated screenshots, so you can find out whether ordinary users can actually complete the tasks unaided. Always includes screenshots; always asks what output format the document should be. Ships the qmsWrapper Documentation PDF pipeline (Chrome print-to-PDF), a highlight-aware screenshot cropper, and the house style.
